title: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
bullets: UI: Dynamic main menu; fades out from the main menu to the first level; reticle only appears when an object is interactable.
Mechanics: Phone functions as a flashlight; switches to 8-bit graphics halfway through the game; story features a loop where the player returns to the same location.
Misc: Small flat; usage of post-processing effects.
Objective Management: Displays objectives in the bottom-left corner of the screen, which then fade out.
Pain Point: Subtitles could be larger, as the spoken audio is in a foreign language.

title: Greyhill Incident
bullets: UI: Dynamic main menu with a side bar layout.
Mechanics: Stamina meter limits sprint duration; voice-line cues trigger when walking off-path (e.g., "I shouldn't be going this way") to soft-gate boundaries.
Misc: Intro cutscenes blend environmental establishing shots of the location with background NPC dialogue.
Objective Management: Objectives can be viewed in the pause menu.
Pain Point: Lack of in-game waypoints; restrictive stamina system; button prompts are too small to read easily.

title: Home Sweet Home
bullets: Controls: Square (flashlight), Triangle (notebook), Circle (crouch), L2 hold (run).
UI: Interactable objects are highlighted visually; dynamic main menu features sound effects when selecting options.
Mechanics: Main ghost uses waypoint pathfinding; enemy detection relies on a cone-shaped vision field (raycasting); distinct audio cue plays when detected by the ghost.
Misc: First-person model shows no body—just the left hand holding a flashlight; Small map design that prevents getting lost.
Objective Management: Briefly displays the current goal at the top-center of the screen before fading out; Pressing Triangle opens a notebook.
Pain Point: Repetitive loop (stealth, obtain item); lack of a reticle;

title: Infliction Extended Cut
bullets: UI: Dynamic main menu rendered in real-time; includes a 'read to plain text' feature for readable notes (needs more polish).
Mechanics: Controller vibration becomes erratic as the ghost gets closer.
Misc: Unsettling ghost animations (running, crawling, twitching blend).
Pain Point: No sprint mechanic; overreliance on jumpscares; reticle doesn't indicate which objects are important since all items are interactable.
